brief.statement: A fashion house, a shop and a school,
brief.muted: on one site, with payments on Reevit.

body: Dasheen Atelier is an Accra fashion house making made-to-measure bridal and traditional wear: wedding gowns, bridesmaids, mothers of the bride, and kente, lace and ceremonial pieces.
Every garment is patterned to the client’s measurements, refined across fittings and finished by hand.
The collection is sold online, each piece made to order in a custom size.
A gown page offers Add to cart or Book a fitting. The cart opens as a drawer, and checkout collects delivery details before handing payment to Reevit.
list: Four steps (service, schedule, details, confirm) across six session types, from a styling session to a virtual consultation.
A measuring studio walks clients through the right measurements for womenswear or menswear.

body: A one-year professional certificate in morning and evening cohorts, taught over six modules from sewing foundations to bespoke finishing.
Applicants apply in two steps, and students sign in to a portal for their measurements, programme and documents.

notes.label: Under the hood
notes.title: Made to order, end to end.
items: Sixteen styles across bridal, bridesmaids, mothers and traditional, each sold in a custom size.
Pick a service, a slot and your details; a summary panel fills in as you go.
Payment runs through Reevit, so card details never touch the store’s own servers.
A two-step application for the fashion school and a sign-in for students and clients.
Open roles for beaders, fashion fellows and seamstresses, each with its own page.
